items.question_en: If the President of a country wishes to resign from office, to whom is the resignation letter submitted?
options_en: Chief Justice of the Supreme Court
items.review_basis: A President resigns by writing addressed to the Vice-President (Article 56(1)(a)).

items.question_en: Who has the power to create a new All India Service?
items.review_basis: Article 312 permits Parliament by law to create an All India Service after the Rajya Sabha's special resolution.

app_practice_resolution.scope: Selected canonical answer includes Parliament creating an All India Service by law. The Rajya Sabha special-resolution prerequisite is additional canonical detail, not an extra publisher-source claim.

items.question_en: Who among the following are not appointed by the President but may be removed by the President?
options_en: Members of a State Public Service Commission
items.review_basis: State Public Service Commission members are appointed by the Governor under Article 316 and may be removed by the President under Article 317. High Court judges and the Attorney General are appointed by the President, so option 1 is uniquely correct; the stored printed key 4 is preserved as a publisher-key conflict.

items.question_te: రాష్ట్రపతి ఎన్నికల్లో పాల్గొనరు. కానీ తొలగింపులో పాల్గొంటారు.
items.question_en: Who do not participate in the presidential election but participate in removal proceedings?
items.review_basis: Nominated MPs participate in impeachment but not the presidential election; State legislators do not participate in impeachment. The visible printed key is not reconcilable with the transcribed options.

items.question_te: రాష్ట్రపతి తొలగింపులో పాల్గొంటారు. కానీ ఎన్నికల్లో పాల్గొనరు
items.question_en: Who participate in the removal of the President but do not participate in the presidential election?
items.review_basis: Nominated MPs, not State MLAs, participate in impeachment while being excluded from the election; exact source wording must be settled.

items.question_te: రాష్ట్రపతి ఎన్నికల్లో పాల్గొంటారు కానీ తొలగింపులో పాల్గొనరు.
items.question_en: Who participate in the presidential election but do not participate in the removal proceedings?
items.review_basis: Elected State MLAs participate in the presidential election but not impeachment.

items.question_en: Which statement concerning the method of presidential election is correct?
options_en: It is conducted by the single transferable vote
It is conducted by a special majority of Parliament
It is conducted by a simple majority of Parliament
items.review_basis: The Indian President is elected by proportional representation through STV; Parliament does not elect the President by a special majority.

items.question_en: Which statement concerning the Vice-President is incorrect?
options_en: The Vice-President is an integral part of the Rajya Sabha
The Vice-President is removed through a special resolution of the Rajya Sabha

All of the above are incorrect
items.review_basis: The Vice-President is elected by members of both Houses voting separately in one electoral college, not at a joint sitting.

రాజ్యసభ చైర్మన్, సభ్యులను నియమించడం, తొలగించడానికి రాష్ట్రపతికి పూర్తి అధికారం ఉంది.
items.question_en: Which of the following is not correct regarding the executive powers of the President of India?
options_en: The President makes all major appointments on the advice of the Prime Minister.
The President appoints the Council of Ministers and the Prime Minister.
The President has complete power to appoint and remove the Chairman and members of the Rajya Sabha.
The President is the Supreme Commander of the defence forces.
items.review_basis: The President does not appoint/remove the Rajya Sabha Chairman or its members as stated in option 3.

items.question_te: భారత రాష్ట్రపతి
options_te: పార్లమెంటు ప్రకారం రెండు సభలలో కంటే ఎక్కువ కావడానికి అనర్హుడు
items.question_en: The President of India:
options_en: is disqualified from being a member of either House of Parliament [retained Telugu wording is awkward]
items.review_basis: Article 79 and the President's address powers support visible options 1 and 3, but option 2 must be exact before resolving all-of-the-above.

items.question_te: భారత ఉపరాష్ట్రపతిని ఎవరు తొలగిస్తారు.
items.question_en: Who removes the Vice-President of India?
options_en: Through a special resolution of the Rajya Sabha
items.review_basis: Removal begins with a Rajya Sabha resolution passed by a majority of all then members and agreed to by Lok Sabha; no generic parliamentary electoral majority applies.

items.question_te: రాష్ట్రపతి ఆర్డినెన్స్ జారీ చేసిన తర్వాత ఎన్ని రోజుల లోపు పార్లమెంటు దానిని ఆమోదించాలి.
items.question_en: Within what period after the President promulgates an ordinance must Parliament approve it?
options_en: Within 6 days of the ordinance being issued
Within 6 weeks of the ordinance being issued
items.review_basis: An ordinance ceases six weeks after Parliament reassembles unless approved earlier; option 2 is academically correct on the visible wording.
